## Definition

**Operationalisation** is the process of defining abstract or theoretical concepts in terms of specific, observable, and measurable procedures. It answers: "How exactly will we measure or manipulate this?"

## Why Operationalise?

| Abstract Concept | Problem | Operationalised |
|------------------|---------|-----------------|
| "Intelligence" | Vague, subjective | Score on WAIS-IV test |
| "Stress" | Many meanings | Cortisol level (ng/mL) |
| "Happiness" | Hard to observe | Rating on 1-10 scale |

## Operationalising IVs

The IV must specify exactly what manipulation occurs:

| Abstract IV | Operationalised |
|-------------|-----------------|
| Caffeine | 200mg caffeine pill vs. placebo |
| Exercise | 30 minutes jogging at 70% max HR |
| Sleep deprivation | Less than 4 hours sleep |
| Stress | 5-minute public speaking task |

## Operationalising DVs

The DV must specify exactly what is measured and how:

| Abstract DV | Operationalised |
|-------------|-----------------|
| Memory | Number of words correctly recalled from a 20-word list |
| Attention | Mean reaction time (ms) on Stroop task |
| Anxiety | Score on State-Trait Anxiety Inventory |
| Performance | Percentage of correct responses |

## Good Operationalisation

| Criterion | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| Specific | Clear, unambiguous definition |
| Measurable | Can be quantified |
| Replicable | Others can use same definition |
| Valid | Captures the intended concept |

## Example: Full Operationalisation

**Research question:** Does caffeine improve memory?

| Component | Abstract | Operationalised |
|-----------|----------|-----------------|
| IV | Caffeine | 200mg caffeine capsule vs. identical placebo |
| DV | Memory | Number of words correctly recalled from a 30-word list after 10-minute delay |
| Participants | Adults | University students aged 18-25 |

## Multiple Operationalisations

The same concept can be operationalised differently:

**"Aggression" could be:**

- Number of aggressive words used
- Intensity of electric shock chosen
- Score on aggression questionnaire
- Observer ratings of behaviour

Different operationalisations may yield different results!

## DataLab Connection

Each DataLab station operationalises concepts clearly. **Reflex Test** operationalises "reaction speed" as time in milliseconds from stimulus onset to button press. **Sixth Sense** operationalises "accuracy" as proportion of correct predictions.
